---
title: "Storage configuration observations"
engine: knitr
---

These are measured run strata, not inferred SSD/network speedups. Storage labels
are configured names, not verified physical-device classifications. Consult the
campaign manifest's input identity, paths and storage mounts before comparisons.
One observed configuration cannot establish a storage comparison.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
source("R/reporting.R")
benchmark_report_page("storage")
```
